Scan quality release — cleaner payloads, no behaviour change on the wire
(the payload format is unchanged, its content just gets more accurate).

- **No more phantom versions from manifest constraints.** A version from a
  constraint (`pillow>=10.0` in pyproject/requirements,
  `find_package(X 1.2)` in CMake) is a floor, not a fact. When a lockfile
  resolves the same package, the resolved version wins and the floor is
  dropped — no duplicate components, no false-positive CVE matches in your
  report. Floors that survive (manifest-only projects) are labelled
  `manifest` with reduced confidence instead of posing as lockfile facts.
- **Build outputs are excluded by default.** `dist/`, `build/`,
  `node_modules/`, `vendor/`, `target/`, `venv/` and hidden directories
  are never scanned — a packaging copy of your source tree no longer
  produces duplicates.
- **New: `.jochwachtignore`.** Commit project-specific excludes at the scan
  root — one glob per line, `#` comments, matching directory names and
  root-relative paths (e.g. `staging`, `firmware/generated`).

Verify what leaves your machine: `jochwacht-sbom . --dry-run`
